svg.title: Frequency response of the CPU pipeline
svg.desc: Gain in decibels of the interval average, the exponential filter and their product, at one sample per second.
svg.text: What the displayed CPU passes (dt = 1 s, tau = 1.5 s)
and beyond it: folded, not removed
The interval average is the only anti-alias filter: its gain at the Nyquist limit is 2/pi (-3.9 dB) and its first sidelobe still passes 21% at 1.4 Hz.
A load faster than 0.5 Hz is attenuated but then reads as a slower one; only an exact multiple of the sampling frequency vanishes.
